stream: every step is one signed batch on the lineage stream, in order

expected_keys.outcome: accept, or reject when the consumer must not apply the step
expected_keys.void_version: for a fill void: new (a version the engine takes), duplicate (the same event again) or regression (a version the engine refuses)
expected_keys.order_state: the order's coarse state after the step
expected_keys.order_confirmed_base_quantity: the order quantity no refused request overrides
expected_keys.order_confirmed_limit_price: the order's limit price, which no refused request overrides
expected_keys.fill_effective_base_quantity: the fill's quantity less its cumulative void
expected_keys.commission_reversal_step: the commission reversal this step adds, in its currency
expected_keys.settled_fill_void_base_quantity_step: the base quantity a fill correction in this step removes from the settled fill its fill_id names: the change since the version last applied
expected_keys.settled_commission_reversal_step: the reversal a fill correction in this step applies to that settled fill's commission, in its currency: the change since the version last applied
expected_keys.flags: integrity marks the consumer raises on the order

fold_rules: a fill's versions are compared by voided quantity, commission reversal and reopen flag together; a fact delivered again is recognised by its event_id
a version with a smaller cumulative void quantity, a smaller absolute commission reversal, or, for a charged fill, no reversal after one was given is not applied
a refused amendment never overrides the confirmed quantity or prices
the signed order_status_after decides the order's state after a void; an order already voided stays voided, whatever its reopen flag

a fill correction applies to the settled fill its fill_id names the change since the version last applied; a version the fold refuses applies nothing, and the next version is measured from the one last applied

covers: one fill voided twice, the cumulative quantity growing
the same correction again, now with its commission: a new version
the same quantity with the reopen flag changed: a new version
the reopen flag changed on an order still open: a new version, and the reopened quantity can fill again
the same fact delivered again is one fact
a smaller cumulative commission reversal is refused
with a charged fill, a reversal once given cannot become absent
with a fill that charged nothing, a zero reversal may later be absent
a rebate is reversed with its own sign
a smaller cumulative void quantity is refused
a void larger than its fill is refused
a reconciliation void of what never filled ends the order, with no correction
a void of what never filled cannot reopen, reverse commission or exceed the order
a void of what never filled cannot reopen, reverse commission or exceed the order
a void of what never filled cannot reopen, reverse commission or exceed the order
an amendment the venue refused does not change the confirmed quantity
a refused price-only amendment names no quantity and keeps the order's
an update carries only the prices the order's type has
an update carries only the prices the order's type has
an update carries only the prices the order's type has
a settled fill corrected again and again: each correction applies the change since the version last applied, and a correction delivered again applies nothing
corrections of a settled fill the fold refuses apply nothing, and the next correction is measured from the version last applied
